issueInvoice.confirm: Are you sure you want to issue an invoice for order <bold>{orderNumber}</bold>? An issued invoice cannot be cancelled here.
issueInvoice.title: Issue invoice

printInvoice.reprintConfirm: Reprint the invoice for order <bold>{orderNumber}</bold>? The original has already been printed, and a reprinted copy is not eligible for the lottery. If the original never came out of the printer, reset it to not printed first.
printInvoice.title: Print invoice

refund.invoiceFailed: The refund went through, but the invoice could not be processed. Handle it in the ECPay portal.
refund.invoiceFailedWithReason: The refund went through, but the invoice could not be processed ({reason}). Handle it in the ECPay portal.
refund.invoiceHint: A full refund first tries to void the invoice; if it cannot be voided (past the filing period, already credited, etc.), a credit note is issued instead.
refund.loadFailed: Could not load previous refunds. Close and try again.
refund.manualChannel: ECPay does not support online refunds for this payment method. This only updates the system record and the invoice — refund the customer via the ECPay portal or in person.
refund.previewFailedWithReason: Could not calculate the refund amount ({reason}). Adjust the quantities or close and try again.
refund.retryBlocked: This refund was not submitted successfully. Refunds cannot be undone — check whether the refundable quantities above have changed, then adjust the quantities to try again.
refund.selectAtLeastOne: Select a quantity for at least one item to refund.
refund.title: Refund

resetInvoicePrint.confirm: Reset the invoice for order <bold>{orderNumber}</bold> to not printed? Do this only if the original never came out of the printer — after resetting, the next print produces a second prize-eligible original.

reason.label: Reason for resetting
reason.placeholder: e.g. Printer jammed, the original never came out

resetInvoicePrint.resetCount: This invoice has already been reset for printing {count} times
resetInvoicePrint.success: Invoice for order {orderNumber} reset to not printed
resetInvoicePrint.title: Reset to not printed

confirm.cancel: Are you sure you want to cancel {count, plural, one {order} other {orders}} <bold>{orderNumbers}</bold>? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.default: Are you sure you want to change {count, plural, one {order} other {orders}} <bold>{orderNumbers}</bold> to <statusText>{status}</statusText>?

voidInvoice.confirm: Void invoice <bold>{invoiceNumber}</bold>? Voiding cannot be undone. A replacement invoice is issued right away with the buyer details below. Invoices that already have a credit note, or that fall outside the filing period, cannot be voided.

customerIdentifier.helperText: Leave blank to keep the buyer details from the voided invoice
customerIdentifier.invalid: The tax ID must be 8 digits
customerIdentifier.label: Correct the tax ID

customerName.helperText: Leave blank to keep the name from the voided invoice
customerName.label: Correct the buyer name

voidInvoice.success: The invoice for order {orderNumber} has been voided
voidInvoice.title: Void invoice

type.callbackFailed: ECPay notification failed verification or processing
type.invoiceOverdue: Order is paid but the invoice has not been issued
type.invoiceSettlementFailed: Refunded, but the invoice was neither voided nor credited
type.invoiceStuck: Invoice stuck while issuing — check the ECPay portal
type.refundUnconfirmed: Refund result unconfirmed; the quantity stays reserved

verification.label: Verify with ECPay
verification.mismatched: ECPay does not match this system — check manually
verification.notUploaded: Not yet uploaded to the tax authority
